content: Jesús tu̱choda bacheno̱danchiy, cadnadunchiy jarye
Satu̱choda ji̱ta Jesús datyadoda niquejadata ruuva, nu̱tyuramusiy riryityu̱chujaya̱sara sisa̱ Ju̱denu, nu̱tyuramusiy, ne riryipyaru̱y tarundamu variy riva.
Satu̱choda ji̱ta: “Savichanu̱yada ti̱qui cadnadu, ja̱mu vicha̱damu. Ne sasuvu̱ñu̱yadani̱ Ju̱denu, dantyamu̱y ne su̱nu̱yada ti̱na̱cho̱, mitya.
Nanuvichanu̱yada ji̱ta bacheno̱da jasintyi, jiryatiy nani̱niñu̱yada japichiy simu cadnadu, nani̱tañu̱yada ji̱ta siva: Ya̱jdutya rajyu̱ra ratyu̱chutasa̱da ratyu̱chuti̱sa̱.

Ne sani jmu̱tyaru̱yada munatya nada. Rivasiy ji̱ta sajachipiya̱jada jivyimu: Danimyu̱y ne rachuvu̱charani̱ Ju̱denu, dantyamu̱y ne nijya̱mi̱, jiryatiy nadayasanta̱danumucha jiñu̱y bacheno̱da ray, ra̱jdutya nadaju̱ra jityu̱chutasa̱da, nañuma paru̱tyatadedanumucha yidedata ray.”
Saniquejada ji̱ta Nutyityu̱ Jesús variy: “Jiryetyuva̱chuta̱tara cadnadu niquejada, jiryatimyu̱ ne vase jvaaryani̱.

Saryityi jdutya cadnadu va̱cha vicharara tara, ¡ta̱ jaryivya̱ju̱ sa̱jdutya Ju̱denura jijeryetasavay tu̱chutasa̱da, jiryatiy rijechiñu̱jeya̱ jna̱rya, nupora jarye siva, dañuma santutyaniy rijechiñu̱ryajiju̱yu!
Ri̱tay jiryiva: Sa̱jdutya varenu jaryuve Ju̱denura rityu̱chutasa̱da. Dañuma sa̱numatiy ju̱ti̱ Nijya̱mi̱denu rayadaju̱ ¿sa̱vidye sarye mucadimu riy nijya̱nvay jiryatiy rityuva̱chusara simu?”
Jesús tu̱choda Varyisévunchiy, criquiy jmutya̱nunchiy jarye sisa̱ju̱
Satu̱choda ji̱tara jirya datyadoda tu̱choda ruuva nijya̱nvay, jiryatiy ru̱nnuva̱yu, rijechipiya̱jadamu daryaju̱ yiteda jivyicha vase jvaavye, rirya̱viryu̱tya̱da variryi tavay.
Satu̱choda ruuva: “Nana̱subeda ji̱ta danu̱ju̱y vanuju̱y Ju̱denu roriñe̱cho̱ju̱, nana̱tidye tu̱chu sisa̱ Ju̱denu. Ti̱qui vicha̱da Varyisévu, nu̱ ji̱ta vicha̱da criquiy jmutya̱nu.

Varyisévu ji̱ta radeda tu̱chu̱ yasiquita: Ju̱denu, ri̱chana̱tya ji, jiryatimyu̱ ne ravyichasara nu̱tyu tavay nijya̱nvay, jiryatiy paranu̱ni̱miryi, varuyu jvaavye, jmuchanutodatavay jarye, varimyata nu̱tyu jiñu criquiy jmutya̱nu rapu̱rya.
Ri̱ndasarara jmyichara daraju̱jyu̱ nu̱ñi taraqui simyanumu; rache̱chara ji̱ta Ju̱denuju̱ra taraquidera nu̱ñi taraqui vu̱yaju̱y ri̱mutya̱ramusiy.

Criquiy jmutya̱nu ji̱ta radeda ripyapude Ju̱denu roriyjisiy, ne sani piradeda na̱vajyu̱, tii, mitya. Mityanuma su̱vatyiñu̱yada jidyutudincha yana̱damu, su̱tañu̱yada variy: ¡Ya̱jantyutyate ray, jiryatiy juuchati̱ ray!

Ri̱tay jiryiva: Su̱musa̱da jaryi samiy jvadichi̱ Ju̱denu diya jiryorimyuju̱ Varyisévumusiy, tapi mi̱ni̱tyi jchana̱tyayu, sa̱cha jantanichi̱ riva; daryaday sa̱chantiy mi̱ni̱tyi jtay jidyetya pasidyeva̱ju̱, sa̱cha ji̱ta jchana̱tyasi̱ rivantidye.”
Jesús jachiñu̱yadara Ju̱denu jmu̱tya̱da deramiy jiyadaju̱

Ruuti̱tanu̱yada ji̱ta nijya̱nvaryi deramidyera pasiñude sa̱ra̱ju̱ simu Jesús, sa̱tidye ju̱riy riñiy, riryetyanusa̱daju̱. Ru̱nu̱yadanumatiy sisa̱ datyavay ru̱tutityiryi deramidyera, ru̱bayada ji̱ta rirya̱jisirya jidyedyeñu jti̱tasa̱da.

Jesús ji̱ta natuyada yimuju̱ varidyeryi, su̱teda ji̱ta yisa̱ datyavavya: “Ne jirya̱niquetta riy deramiy, rirya̱ma̱ ju̱ti̱ rimu. Ne jirya̱jbarya ruuti̱jada, tapi rityi ra̱chasara Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomu, riñi̱cha nu̱tyu deramidyera.
Ri̱tay si̱tenu jiryiva: Mi̱ni̱tyimyu̱ ne ra̱jmutya̱ra Ju̱denu nusu̱yada, nu̱tyu su̱mutya̱ derade samiy jachitya daryara, ne sa̱jachara variy Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomu, tii, mitya.”
Satu̱choda vadero̱nu jaryi tarati̱ sisa̱ Jesús
Sitaja̱doda ji̱ta ti̱qui nutyityu̱ni̱ Jesús: “Datyanu̱ sami̱, ¿ta̱ra jvaayadata ra̱jmutya̱ra rayaru̱rya ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yada, ta̱ra jvaayadata?”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva: “¿Ta̱ju̱ra yitay sami̱ darye, ta̱ju̱? Ne ti̱ sami̱, vinu Ju̱denu.

Jiñi̱ ji̱ta datyara Ju̱denu datyadoda: Ne vurya̱rupi ti̱ vaturu̱jsa̱, ne vurya̱jvañi̱ ti̱, ne vurya̱paranu risa̱ju̱, ne vurya̱niquera quivu̱yada ti̱nijyu̱ntiy; vurya̱ma̱ tuva̱chu simu vu̱jye̱, vuryi̱no̱damu jarye.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta nutyityu̱ variy siva Jesús: “Vadinudemusiy ratyuva̱chunu̱yada ramu ti̱ta̱ju̱.”

Satuva̱chodanumatiy Jesúsra saniquejada, su̱teda ji̱ta siva: “Rasu̱tyedye tarade ji. Ya̱ta̱ryu̱tyara jiberya ti̱ta̱ju̱, jadchiy ji̱ta ya̱sa̱y ruuva jantyuyadavarya ramurichirya. Variñi̱ ji̱ta ye̱cha tarati̱ jarichumu. Varenumacu̱, ya̱siityari̱sara varirye.”
Satuva̱chodanumatirya Jesús niquejada, sayiveda ji̱ta jaryi variy, jiryatiy jaryi tarati̱ daryaju̱ dañi̱.
Jesús jnu̱yada jiñiquejada sa̱ra̱ju̱ sana̱cho̱, saniquejada ji̱ta variy: “Ta̱ jaryi surra ravichasara rijyu̱ jaryi taratavay Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomu jayada day.
Saryityi ramije camélluquisuma rodanru̱ju̱ vimu, saryi jay ji̱ta jaryi tarati̱ variy Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomuntidye.”
Rityi tuva̱chodara saniquejada, ruutaja̱doda ji̱ta variñi̱: “¿Chi̱na̱ ra̱ramityasarate, chi̱?”
Su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “Jiryatimyu̱ ne vana̱y sivaayada nijya̱mi̱ra, vinu Ju̱denu ji̱ta ra̱jvaachara darya.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Pyítrubay variy siva: “Nu̱y ji̱ta tochedara jiryoridye, nu̱chiityari̱jada variy ji.”

Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva: “Ri̱tay si̱tenu jiryiva: Ni̱tiy tochiy Ju̱denu nusu̱yada jiyasachirya jiryoriy, varimyata savaturu̱y, varimyata sataryi̱veda, varimyata saja̱vyeda, varimyata sadadyeñu, sa̱day jmutya̱ ji̱ta jijyomu jaryi rayadaju̱, tarundamunuma ji̱ta sa̱jmutya̱ra ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadantiy.”
Sajatyiiyada tu̱choda Jesús jibetyedajiju̱

Sa̱ra̱cheda ji̱ta Jesús variryi yisa̱ datyavay, vu̱yaju̱y, danu̱ju̱y rinchaju̱, su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “Vurya̱sumiñuma ji̱ta Jerusarí̱muju̱. Jto̱tanichara ra̱cha variy Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chuvabe niquejada ti̱ta̱ju̱, jiryatiy riñu̱yada sanchiy Nijya̱mi̱denura.
Rirya̱sa̱y ji̱ta ma̱myimyuni̱ Nijya̱mi̱denu, rirya̱jarupanta variñi̱, rirya̱javityiye̱ risa̱ju̱ni̱, rirya̱tochiye̱ variy siva risa̱ju̱ntiy.
Rimyusiye̱yadivasiy ya̱jvañi̱. Mumurundamimyusiy ji̱ta, sa̱mi̱sa̱sumiy diibyimusintyi.”
Sisa̱ datyavay ji̱ta, ne datya̱dara Jesús niquejada, mitya. Dutyasara daryaju̱ rijyu̱ra saniquejada, ramuni̱mu̱y ne ridyetya̱dara.
Jesús mi̱sadedani̱ ni̱sipyuryi, Jericó ja̱mi̱
Satuudiyadanumatiy Jesúsra Jericó, savicha̱da ji̱ta ni̱sipyuryi nú̱tuva̱rya, jadchityi sajachiñu̱ñu̱yada jimya̱sajomusiy tara ruuva nijya̱nvay.
Satuva̱chodanumatiy ni̱sipyuryirya riryamityityiyada nijya̱nvajyuu, sitaja̱doda ji̱ta variy: “¿Ta̱ra rani̱cha daryamusiy, ta̱ra?”
Ru̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta variñi̱: “Ni̱numa Jesús ramiryi̱, Nasaryémusi̱.”
Saniquejasubeda ji̱ta variy: “¡Jesús, Davyíbe jasi̱, ya̱jantyutyate ray!”
Rityi rupiryi̱jada Jesúsjisiy, riñique̱tya̱da variñi̱, riñi ndasaniryu̱yada variy jasiñi̱. Sasa̱ñe̱ya̱jada ji̱ta jaryi varidye: “¡Davyíbe jasi̱, ya̱jantyutyate ray! ¡Ya̱jantyutyate ray!”
Saraniñuvi̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variy jasiy, saryitya̱tadeda yimuju̱ variñi̱. Satuudiyadanumatiy ni̱sipyuryiñi̱, sitaja̱doda Jesús variñi̱:
“¿Nu̱tyura jivya̱ta ra̱chaniy ji, nu̱tyura?” Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱tani̱: “¡Ri̱nu̱yasumiryu̱y ju̱na̱dye, Nutyityu̱!”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva: “Ya̱numa jnu̱yasumíy, ra̱ntyumya̱ jityuva̱choda yiva.”

Varicha̱ra̱ju̱de raratyesubeda sani̱siy varidye, sasiityari̱jada ji̱ta variñi̱ Jesús, si̱chana̱tyatityiyada variñi̱ Ju̱denu. Nijya̱nvay jarye, jiryatiy ridyi daryaju̱ riva sami̱sa̱da, riichana̱tya̱da ji̱ta variñi̱ Ju̱denu riva.
